text_en: Looks like the regiment inspecting the western cave's finally started to come out.
I wouldn't 'ave gone in there for anything in the world.
Gimme a break. You'd 'ave gone wherever you were ordered...
Ah, 'spose. Who am I ladding? They find what we were looking for?
Not "what", but "who". Some kind of God on earth. But there were only monsters.
Wow... Wonder what it looks like...
